source_run: Root-executed client-r2; corrected screenshots now stored in client-final.
method: Each of the 12 PNGs was opened individually with view_image detail=original and visually inspected. Hashes identify the exact inspected files.
scope: English and Chinese, effective GUI scales 2 and 3, Settings/Skill slots/Metal former. Japanese six screenshots are reviewed separately by root.
limitations: Visual review of these captured states; runtime interaction and narration assertions belong to the root-executed client gate, not to this image review.
